title: Hint, a new AI startup co-founded by Martha Stewart, offers an AI assistant for homeowners | TechCrunch
summary: Martha Stewart is entering the AI software era in the most Martha Stewart way possible: she has joined the co-founding team at Hint, an app that leverages AI technology to manage the tasks surrounding home maintenance and management.
